logo-system.alt: Zingara logo system: the wordmark, a stacked lockup with a spice ornament, and the mark reversed out of true red, shown beside the palette and type hierarchy.

typography.alt: The Zingara type specimen. A display serif and a sans in three weights, a four-level hierarchy, and a wordmark letterspacing study comparing tight against wide tracking at +200 optical spacing.

palette.alt: The Zingara colour system: true red, charcoal, cream and burnished gold with their tints and shades, a 60/20/10/10 usage ratio, and a grid of approved and rejected colour pairings.

patterns.alt: Eight-pattern texture library: Spice Geometry, Steam Abstraction, Rice Grain Field, Karnataka Line Weave, Handi Silhouette, Arabesque Spice, Saffron Scatter and Nineteen Cipher.

ammas-breakfast.alt: Amma's Breakfast by Zingara: the sub-brand logo, set in a warm script quite unlike the Zingara wordmark.

logo-rules.alt: The expanded Zingara logo system: primary wordmark, a secondary lockup carrying "Not Your Usual Biryani", and a Z monogram with a star-anise flourish; eight colour versions; clear space set to the height of the Z; minimum sizes of 50, 30 and 15 millimetres; and three do-nots: do not stretch, do not recolour, do not rotate.

specimen.alt: The Zingara type specimen. Cormorant Garamond in light, regular, semibold and bold as the primary face; DM Sans in regular, medium and bold as the secondary; and a wordmark letterspacing study setting the chosen +200 optical tracking against tight and wide alternatives.

icons.alt: Twelve line icons in two colourways: mortar and pestle, steam, cardamom, handi, fire, star anise, nutmeg, cinnamon, the numeral 19, a covered dish, cutlery, and a Zingara Mysore roundel, with rule dividers and corner ornaments.

collateral.alt: Menu and print collateral: a hardback menu book open on a spread, business cards in charcoal and true red, letterhead with a wax-sealed envelope, a compliments voucher, a numbered table tent and a leather menu folder.

packaging.alt: The packaging system: a charcoal presentation box with a gold seal, a patterned carrier bag, a delivery container with a red wax-seal label reading Mysore White Biryani, and spice jars, shown beside the four palette chips they are built from.

signage.alt: Exterior and signage at night: an illuminated facade sign, frosted window etching, an A-frame sidewalk board reading "Not your usual biryani", and an awning over the street frontage.

interior.alt: The interior: a dining room under pendant lights, a branded feature wall reading Zingara, Mysore White Biryani, 19 Spice Blend, a table setting with a numbered marker and a menu card, and the counter and takeaway area.

delivery.alt: Delivery and outdoor presence: a rider with an insulated Zingara bag, a bus-shelter advertisement, a food-festival pop-up stall, and a branded scooter wrap.

web-ui.alt: Website and app interface: a desktop homepage with the wordmark over a biryani photograph, a mobile hero and order app, an online menu page laid out in three columns, and an order-confirmation screen reading "Your Zingara is on the way."

social.alt: Social identity: a nine-post Instagram grid alternating food photography with typographic panels reading "Not your usual biryani" and "19 spices. Built, not coated.", two Stories frames, and the Z brand avatar on true red.
